hints.title: Leaf to Root Determination
hints.text: For any leaf node, the only operation that can toggle its incident edge is toggling the leaf itself.

hints.title: Post-Order Tree Invariant
hints.text: Traverse the tree from bottom up. For each child v with parent u, if edge (u, v) is 1, node v must be toggled.

hints.title: Root Parity Verification
hints.text: After resolving all child edges, check if the root has any remaining unresolved edges. If not, the total toggled nodes is the unique minimal answer.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all 2^n toggle subsets is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recursion stack and toggle state take O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects bottom-up greedy uniqueness property on trees.
